RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

An all-female panel is not evidence of bias; interview panels are typically formed based on availability, seniority, and relevant division representation. The successful candidate was also shortlisted and possesses strong, relevant qualifications. At the final shortlist stage, hiring decisions in government typically turn on interview performance, cultural fit, and specific project experience rather than paper credentials alone.

A two-week wait for written feedback is standard civil service bureaucracy. Raising gender bias without concrete evidence of improper scoring or procedural irregularities would be unfounded and could significantly damage your professional reputation. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback focused entirely on how you can strengthen future applications.
